Thirty-five years ago, the impulse which has since been organized as the Zionist Movement led my parents to leave their homes in Roumania and emigrate to Palestine, where they joined a number of other Jewish pioneers in founding Zicron-Jacob--a little village lying just south of Mount Carmel, in that fertile coastal region close to the ancient Plains of Armageddon.

arxiv-2105-02293.title: Future constraints on the reionization history and the ionizing sources from Gamma-ray Burst Afterglows
arxiv-2105-02293.creator: Adam Lidz 1 , Tzu-Ching Chang 2,3 , Lluís Mas-Ribas 2,3 , Guochao Sun 3
arxiv-2105-02293.description: Abstract We forecast the reionization history constraints, inferred from Lyman-alpha damping wing absorption features, for a future sample of ∼ 20 \sim 20 z ≥ 6 z\geq 6 gamma-ray burst (GRB) afterglows. We describe each afterglow spectrum by a three-parameter model. First, L L characterizes the size of the ionized region (the “bubble size”) around a GRB host halo.

arxiv-2106-12048.title: The Dirichlet problem for a family of totally degenerate differential operators Thanks: ⋆ Corresponding author.
arxiv-2106-12048.creator: Maria Manfredini a , Mirco Piccinini b,⋆ , Sergio Polidoro c
arxiv-2106-12048.description: Abstract . In the framework of the Potential Theory we prove existence and uniqueness for the Perron-Wiener-Brelot solution to the Dirichlet problem related to a family of totally degenerate, in the sense of Bony, differential operators. We also state and prove a Wiener-type criterium and an exterior cone condition for boundary regularity.

arxiv-2106-15434.title: Zoo-Tuning: Adaptive Transfer from a Zoo of Models
arxiv-2106-15434.creator: Yang Shu, Zhi Kou, Zhangjie Cao, Jianmin Wang, Mingsheng Long
arxiv-2106-15434.description: Abstract With the development of deep networks on various large-scale datasets, a large zoo of pretrained models are available. When transferring from a model zoo, applying classic single-model based transfer learning methods to each source model suffers from high computational burden and cannot fully utilize the rich knowledge in the zoo.

arxiv-2112-10478.title: A test of galaxy cluster fundamental plane for the X-COP sample
arxiv-2112-10478.creator: S. Pradyumna, Shantanu Desai
arxiv-2112-10478.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Pradyumna, Shantanu Desai. We test the galaxy cluster fundamental plane using the X-COP sample of 12 clusters. The fundamental plane is given by the relation T X ∝ M s α ​ r s β T_{X}\propto M_{s}^{\alpha}r_{s}^{\beta} , where T X T_{X} , M s M_{s} , and r s r_{s} correspond to the gas temperature, NFW halo mass, and scale radius, respectively.

arxiv-2204-07476.title: Guiding Attention using Partial-Order Relationships for Image Captioning
arxiv-2204-07476.creator: Murad Popattia, Muhammad Rafi, Rizwan Qureshi, Shah Nawaz
arxiv-2204-07476.description: Abstract The use of attention models for automated image captioning has enabled many systems to produce accurate and meaningful descriptions for images. Over the years, many novel approaches have been proposed to enhance the attention process using different feature representations.

arxiv-2208-00033.title: Personalised recommendations of sleep behaviour with neural networks using sleep diaries captured in Sleepio TM
arxiv-2208-00033.creator: Alejo Nevado-HolgadoUniversity of Oxford alejo.nevado-holgado@psych.ox.ac.uk Colin Espie, Sleepio colin@sleepio.com Maria LiakataUniversity of Warwick m.liakata@warwick.ac.uk Alasdair Henry, Sleepio alasdair.henry@sleepio.com Jenny Gu, Sleepio jenny.gu@sussex.ac.uk Niall TaylorUniversity of Oxford n
arxiv-2208-00033.description: Abstract Sleepio TM is a digital mobile phone and web platform that uses techniques from cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) to improve sleep in people with sleep difficulty. As part of this process, Sleepio captures data about the sleep behaviour of the users that have consented to such data being processed.

arxiv-2303-12986.title: Self-sustained deformable rotating liquid He cylinders: The pure normal fluid 3 He and superfluid 4 He cases
arxiv-2303-12986.creator: Martí Pi, Francesco Ancilotto, Manuel Barranco, Samuel L. Butler, José María Escartín
arxiv-2303-12986.description: Abstract We have studied self-sustained, deformable, rotating liquid He cylinders of infinite length. In the normal fluid 3 He case, we have employed a classical model where only surface tension and centrifugal forces are taken into account, as well as the Density Functional Theory (DFT) approach in conjunction with a semi-classical Thomas-Fermi approximation for the kinetic energy.

arxiv-2304-02030.title: Gravitoelectric dynamical tides at second post-Newtonian order
arxiv-2304-02030.creator: Manoj K. Mandal, Pierpaolo Mastrolia, Hector O. Silva, Raj Patil, Jan Steinhoff
arxiv-2304-02030.description: Abstract We present a gravitoelectric quadrupolar dynamical tidal-interaction Hamiltonian for a compact binary system, that is valid to second order in the post-Newtonian expansion. Our derivation uses the diagrammatic effective field theory approach, and involves Feynman integrals up to two loops, evaluated with the dimensional regularization scheme.

arxiv-2307-10823.title: GPU-based optical photon simulation for the LHCb RICH 1 Detector
arxiv-2307-10823.creator: Yunlong Li, Adam Davis, Sajan Easo, Keith Evans, Evelina Mihova Gersabeck, Marco Gersabeck, Lucas George Girardey, Raja Nandakumar, Annabelle Jane Pointer
arxiv-2307-10823.description: Abstract We present the investigation of the use of Opticks , a GPU-accelerated optical photon interface with the LHCb detector simulation, to improve computation time of optical photon propagation. The hybrid workflow, combining the particle simulation package Geant4 and Opticks , offloads optical photon propagation to GPUs, thereby accelerating the overall simulation process.

arxiv-2308-00281.title: Online Stochastic Allocation of Reusable Resources
arxiv-2308-00281.creator: Xilin Zhang, Wang Chi Cheung
arxiv-2308-00281.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xilin Zhang, Wang Chi Cheung. We study a multi-objective model on the allocation of reusable resources under model uncertainty. Heterogeneous customers arrive sequentially according to a latent stochastic process, request for certain amounts of resources, and occupy them for random durations of time. The decision maker’s goal is to simultaneously maximize multiple types of rewards generated by the customers, while satisfying the resource capacity constraints in each time step. We develop models and algorithms for deciding on the allocation actions.

arxiv-2309-08370.title: Gallai-Ramsey multiplicity for rainbow small trees Supported by NSFC No.12131013 and 12161141006.
arxiv-2309-08370.creator: Xueliang Li, Yuan Si
arxiv-2309-08370.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xueliang Li, Yuan Si. Let G , H G,H be two non-empty graphs and k k be a positive integer. The Gallai-Ramsey number gr k ⁡ ( G : H ) \operatorname{gr}_{k}(G:H) is defined as the minimum positive integer N N such that for all n ≥ N n\geq N , every k k -edge-coloring of K n K_{n} contains either a rainbow subgraph G G or a monochromatic subgraph H H .

arxiv-2403-09516.title: Leveraging Prototypical Representations for Mitigating Social Bias without Demographic Information
arxiv-2403-09516.creator: Shadi Iskander Kira Radinsky Yonatan Belinkov
arxiv-2403-09516.description: Abstract Mitigating social biases typically requires identifying the social groups associated with each data sample. In this paper, we present DaFair , a novel approach to address social bias in language models. Unlike traditional methods that rely on explicit demographic labels, our approach does not require any such information.

arxiv-2409-10831.title: PDMX: A Large-Scale P ublic D omain M usic X ML Dataset for Symbolic Music Processing Thanks: © 2025 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. arxiv-2409-10831.creator: Phillip Long, Zachary Novack, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Julian McAuley
arxiv-2409-10831.description: Abstract The recent explosion of generative AI-Music systems has raised numerous concerns over data copyright, licensing music from musicians, and the conflict between open-source AI and large prestige companies. Such issues highlight the need for publicly available, copyright-free musical data, in which there is a large shortage, particularly for symbolic music data.

arxiv-2501-13794.title: Unveiling the Power of Noise Priors: Enhancing Diffusion Models for Mobile Traffic Prediction
arxiv-2501-13794.creator: Zhi Sheng, Yuan Yuan, Jingtao Ding, Yong Li
arxiv-2501-13794.description: Abstract Accurate prediction of mobile traffic, i.e., network traffic from cellular base stations, is crucial for optimizing network performance and supporting urban development. However, the non-stationary nature of mobile traffic, driven by human activity and environmental changes, leads to both regular patterns and abrupt variations.

arxiv-2510-00231.title: The Pitfalls of KV Cache Compression
arxiv-2510-00231.creator: Alex Chen, Renato Geh, Aditya Grover, Guy Van den Broeck, Daniel Israel
arxiv-2510-00231.description: Abstract KV cache compression promises increased throughput and efficiency with negligible loss in performance. While the gains in throughput are indisputable and recent literature has indeed shown minimal degradation on particular benchmarks, in general the consequences of compression in realistic scenarios such as multi-instruction prompting have been insufficiently studied.

arxiv-2510-09478.title: Site-Specific RIS Deployment in Cellular Networks via Calibrated Ray Tracing This work was in part supported by H2020-MSCA-ITN-2020 META WIRELESS (Grant Agreement: 956256), by the SNS JU Horizon Europe Project under Grant Agreement No. 101139161 (INSTINCT), by the 6G-Machine Intelligence based Radio
arxiv-2510-09478.creator: Sina Beyraghi † ⁣ ⋆ {}^{\dagger\,\star} , Javad Shabanpour ♭ , Giovanni Geraci ⋆ , Paul Almasan † , and Angel Lozano ⋆
arxiv-2510-09478.description: Abstract This work introduces a fully-automated RIS deployment strategy validated through a digital twin, powered by Sionna ray tracing, of a UK city. On a scene calibrated with measured data, the method jointly optimizes RIS placement, orientation, configuration, and BS beamforming across 4G, 5G, and hypothetical 6G frequencies.

arxiv-2512-18104.title: Microstructure-based Variational Neural Networks for Robust Uncertainty Quantification in Materials Digital Twins
arxiv-2512-18104.creator: Andreas E. Robertson, Samuel B. Inman, Ashley T. Lenau, Ricardo A. Lebensohn, Dongil Shin, Brad L. Boyce, Rémi M. Dingreville
arxiv-2512-18104.description: Abstract Aleatoric uncertainties – irremovable variability in microstructure morphology, constituent behavior, and processing conditions – pose a major challenge to developing uncertainty-robust digital twins. We introduce the Variational Deep Material Network (VDMN), a physics-informed surrogate model that enables efficient and probabilistic forward and inverse predictions of material behavior.

pmc-10601416.title: Eco-Friendly High-Performance Thin-Layer Chromatography Method for the Determination of Tenoxicam in Commercial Formulations
pmc-10601416.creator: Faiyaz Shakeel, Prawez Alam, Nazrul Haq, Mohammed H. Alqarni
pmc-10601416.description: There is a dearth of information in the literature regarding environmentally benign high-performance thin-layer chromatography (HPTLC) methods to determine tenoxicam (TNX). Therefore, designing and validating an HPTLC method to detect TNX in commercial tablets and capsules was the goal of this investigation. The green mobile phase utilized was the combination of ethanol/water/ammonia solution (50:45:5 v/v/v).

pmc-11454369.title: 7576 A Rare and Atypical Presentation of Bladder Paraganglioma in a Patient on Long-Term Left Ventricular Assist Device
pmc-11454369.creator: Suphadetch David Leungsuwan, Shaun Jian Jie Lee, Shao Ting Dawn Lim, Lih Ming Lo
pmc-11454369.description: Disclosure: S.D. Leungsuwan: None. S.J. Lee: None. S.D. Lim: None. L. Loh: None. Background: Paragangliomas (PGLs) are rare neuroendocrine tumors arising from chromaffin cells. Capable of producing catecholamines, functional PGLs often cause a myriad of autonomic symptoms and complications, including cardiomyopathy. We report a case of bladder PGL in a patient on Left Ventricular Assist Device (LVAD).

pmc-11461189.title: Temporal artery biopsy in giant cell arteritis: clinical perspectives and histological patterns
pmc-11461189.creator: Pavlos Stamatis, Carl Turesson, Aladdin J. Mohammad
pmc-11461189.description: Although its role has been debated, temporal artery biopsy (TAB) remains the gold standard for the diagnosis of cranial giant cell arteritis (GCA). The specificity of TAB is excellent and the sensitivity, albeit lower, is comparable with other diagnostic modalities used for the diagnosis of GCA.

pmc-11500338.title: Floods modeling and analysis for Dubai using HEC-HMS model and remote sensing using GIS
pmc-11500338.creator: Ihsanullah R Khan, Samy I Elmahdy, Rabee Rustum, Qasim Khan, Mohamed M Mohamed
pmc-11500338.description: Floods accompanied by thunderstorms in developed cities are hazardous, causing damage to infrastructure. To secure infrastructure, it is important to employ an integrated approach, combining remote sensing, GIS and precipitation data. The model was developed based on the estimation of event-based runoff and investigated the relationship between runoff and impervious surfaces.

pmc-11602139.title: PCNA-binding activity separates RNF168 functions in DNA replication and DNA double-stranded break signaling
pmc-11602139.creator: Yang Yang, Deepika Jayaprakash, Satpal S Jhujh, John J Reynolds, Steve Chen, Yanzhe Gao, Jay Ramanlal Anand, Elizabeth Mutter-Rottmayer, Pablo Ariel, Jing An, Xing Cheng, Kenneth H Pearce, Sophie-Anne Blanchet, Nandana Nandakumar, Pei Zhou, Amélie Fradet-Turcotte, Grant S Stewart, Cyrus Vaziri
pmc-11602139.description: RNF168 orchestrates a ubiquitin-dependent DNA damage response to regulate the recruitment of repair factors, such as 53BP1 to DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs). In addition to its canonical functions in DSB signaling, RNF168 may facilitate DNA replication fork progression. However, the precise role of RNF168 in DNA replication remains unclear.

pmc-11625684.title: Influence of TyG Index on Large Vascular Occlusive Stroke Following Endovascular Treatment
pmc-11625684.creator: Wei Sun, Huixin Shen, Xiao Wu, Aini He, Xuefan Yao, Fei Chen, Haiqing Song, Xiaoqin Huang
pmc-11625684.description: AimsThis study aimed to investigate the impact of the triglyceride‐glucose index (TyG index) on clinical consequences in individuals with large vascular occlusion (LVO)‐induced acute ischemic stroke (AIS) following endovascular treatment (EVT).MethodsWe conducted a single‐center retrospective cohort study, including AIS with LVO who underwent EVT.

pmc-11710809.title: Downregulation of α‐synuclein in a mouse model of Alzheimer’s Disease: neuropathological, behavioral and transcriptomic changes
pmc-11710809.creator: Andre Direito Goulart Leitao, Rijwan Uddin Ahammad, Brian Spencer, Chengbiao Wu, Robert A. Rissman
pmc-11710809.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundNeurodegenerative disorders of aging are characterized by the progressive accumulation of proteins such as α‐synuclein (α‐syn) and amyloid beta (Aβ). Misfolded and aggregated α‐syn has been implicated in neurological disorders such as Parkinson’s disease (PD), and Dementia with Lewy Bodies (DLB), but less so in Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) despite the fact that synuclein pathology is present in over 50% of postmortem brains of AD patients.

pmc-13107070.title: Examining suicide literacy among emerging adult medical students in Puerto Rico
pmc-13107070.creator: Fabio Barreto-Ayes, Estefany Velez-Baez, Erik Velez-Perez, Elina Aguilar-Jiménez, Mario Bermonti-Pérez, Norka Polanco-Frontera, Eliut Rivera-Segarra, Anonymous, Franco Mascayano, Gonzalo Martínez-Alés Garcia, Jerome Galea, Anonymous, Gonzalo Martínez-Alés Garcia, Jerome Galea
pmc-13107070.description: Keywords: emerging adults, suicide literacy, young adults, mental health, risk factors Impact statements Emerging adults (EAs, aged 18–29 years) face high vulnerability to suicidal ideation and attempts due to the developmental instability, identity exploration and multiple role transitions that characterize this stage of life.

pmc-13301571.title: Beyond pulmonary vein isolation: impact of posterior wall and SVC isolation in a zero-fluoroscopy, ICE-guided PFA workflow
pmc-13301571.creator: G Pontes Saad, J Araujo F Fernandes, G Vignoli Dos Santos, L A Inacio Jr, C Slater, E Saad
pmc-13301571.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionPulsed field ablation (PFA) selectively targets myocardial tissue while sparing adjacent structures such as the esophagus and phrenic nerve, allowing lesion extension beyond the pulmonary veins without increasing the risk of collateral damage.

pmc-13384110.title: Peanut shell-derived nickel cobalt oxide@carbon and activated carbon for high-energy supercapacitor electrodes
pmc-13384110.creator: Sokhna Dieng, Ndeye Maty Ndiaye, Ndeye Fatou Sylla, Bridget K. Mutuma, Balla Diop Ngom
pmc-13384110.description: The concept of employing green technology for energy applications is appealing and increasingly necessary as fossil fuels continue to deplete. This study investigates the use of sustainable carbon-based materials derived from peanut shell extracts and incorporated into a nickel cobalt oxide (NiCo2O4) matrix through a green synthesis route for high-performance supercapacitor applications.

pmc-13568253.title: Quince Seed and Flaxseed Mucilage as Natural Viscosity-Modifying Agents in Cementitious Composites: Rheological, Fresh-State and Mechanical Performance
pmc-13568253.creator: Ayşe Türk, Furkan Türk, Hayriye Nur Nayan, Çisem Kırbıyık Kurukavak, Ülkü Sultan Keskin
pmc-13568253.description: This study evaluated the feasibility of using mucilage derived from plant seeds as a viscosity-modifying agent in cementitious composites. Mucilages derived from quince seeds (quince seed mucilage, QSM) and flax seeds (flaxseed mucilage, FSM)-which are readily available, low-cost, and sustainable sources of hydrocolloids-were dried and ground into powder, then used as viscosity-modifying agents in cementitious mixtures.
